newsitem.title: CANADA: Rogers CEO Rogers to retire within 6 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Rogers CEO Rogers to retire within 6 yrs.

text.p: Rogers Communications Inc Chief Executive Ted Rogers said on Friday that he planned to retire as chief executive within six years.
Rogers told the annual meeting that he also planned to appoint a chief operating officer for Rogers Communications within three years.

"This month I will be 64. I'm feeling great but I have had an aneurism, a heart attack and a bypass," Rogers told shareholders. "While I enjoy immensely what I do and wish to continue, it's time to plan for succession.
